Message.MsgText: Must call the initialize method first!

Explanation.p: An attempt to use an uninitialized Function Component has been detected. This error may occur if the initialize method has not be successfully called before calling other Function Component methods. This may also occur if a Function Component method has been called after calling terminate.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the calling code so that initialize method has been successfully called before calling other Function Component methods.

Message.MsgText: Entry Attribute ''attribute name'' missing value.

Explanation.p: A mandatory attribute is missing or is missing a value.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the AssemblyLine mapping or client code so that the named attribute has a value.

Message.MsgText: Entry Attribute ''attribute name'' missing value or value does not match expected type. Expected type: ''document type''.

Explanation.p: A mandatory attribute is missing or is missing a value of the correct type.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the AssemblyLine mapping or client code so that the named attribute has a value and its type is as expected. See Users Guide for details.

Message.MsgText: Entry attribute ''attribute name'' must be one of 'xmlDomDocument', 'xmlString', or 'multiValuedAttributes'.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the AssemblyLine mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: Entry object expected.

Explanation.p: The object type passed the Function Components perform method was not a SyncWeave Entry.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the client code.

Message.MsgText: Must call initialize() first.

Explanation.p: An attempt has been made to use an uninitialized Function Component.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the client code. Ensure the initialize method is called before using the Function Component. Ensure the Function Component is not use after calling its terminate method.

Message.MsgText: Function cannot be reused once terminate() has been called.

Explanation.p: An attempt has been made to use the Function Component after its terminate method has been called.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the client code. Ensure the initialize method is called before using the Function Component. Ensure the Function Component is not use after calling its terminate method.

Message.MsgText: ''class name'' != ''class name''.

Explanation.p: The classname does not match the expected classname.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the AssemblyLine attribute mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: Mandatory RFC parameter named ''field name'' has not been supplied.

Explanation.p: RFC modules in SAP often define mandatory import and table parameters. The parameters must be present when calling the RFC.

OperatorResponse.p: For the RFC being called, use transaction SE37 in the target SAP system to determine the mandatory RFC parameters. Correct the AssemblyLine attribute mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: Length of supplied value for field ''field name'' exceeds maximum length ''field length''.

Explanation.p: The length of the value supplied for the named RFC parameters or table parameter field exceeds the maximum length defined by the RFC in the target SAP system.

OperatorResponse.p: For the RFC being called, use transaction SE37 in the target SAP system to determine the length of the given RFC parameter or table parameter field. Correct the AssemblyLine attribute mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: ''class name'' does not equal ''class name''.

Explanation.p: The classname does not match the expected classname.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the AssemblyLine attribute mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: Mandatory RFC parameter named ''field name'' has not been supplied.

Explanation.p: RFC modules in SAP often define mandatory import and table parameters. The parameters must be present when calling the RFC.

OperatorResponse.p: For the RFC being called, use transaction SE37 in the target SAP system to determine the mandatory RFC parameters. Correct the AssemblyLine attribute mapping or client code.

Message.MsgText: No such function named ''function name''.

Explanation.p: The entry attributes and values represent an RFC request for an RFC module that does not exist in the target SAP system, or has not been released.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the RFC exists on the target SAP system. Ensure the RFC name is correctly specified in the entry.

Message.MsgText: The remove method is not implemented.

OperatorResponse.p: See the Users Guide.

OperatorResponse.p: Restart the AssemblyLine.

OperatorResponse.p: Restart the AssemblyLine.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the network is available. Ensure the target SAP system is available.

OperatorResponse.p: Ensure the network is available. Ensure the target SAP system is available.
